title: Using Large Language Models to Detect and Understand Drug Discontinuation Events in Web-Based Forums: Development and Validation Study
summary: Zero-shot BART, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o and DeBERTa classified drug-discontinuation events and root causes in MedHelp forum comments. In a dataset of 1,000 comments (107 labeled events), BART achieved F1 0.86 for event detection, with 2.8% false positives and 6.5% false negatives; GPT-4o had 12.9% Hamming loss for root-cause classification. The result is a text-mining evaluation on this annotated forum sample, not evidence of medication adherence or clinical outcomes.
ai_technology: BART, GPT-4o and DeBERTa zero-shot classifiers

evidence.tested: Evaluated zero-shot classifiers on MedHelp forum comments: among 1,000 comments, 107 were drug-discontinuation events; BART reached F1 0.86, 2.8% false-positive rate and 6.5% false-negative rate, while GPT-4o root-cause classification had 12.9% Hamming loss.
evidence.unknown: Performance is established only on the annotated MedHelp forum sample; it does not establish population prevalence, medication adherence, or clinical outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: BART, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o and DeBERTa classify forum-comment sentences for drug-discontinuation events and root causes without task-specific fine-tuning.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
